# sharepoint_site_design (Resource)

Creates a SharePoint site design (site template) using the M365 CLI (m365 spo sitedesign add). A site design references one or more sharepoint_site_script resources and can be applied to a site via sharepoint_site_design_apply. All attributes can be updated in-place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sharepoint_site_design" "department" {
  title        = "Department site"
  description  = "Standard layout for department communication sites."
  web_template = "CommunicationSite"
  site_scripts = [sharepoint_site_script.department.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `site_scripts` (List of String) Ordered list of sharepoint_site_script IDs to run when this design is applied. Scripts run in the order listed.
- `title` (String) Display name of the site design.
- `web_template` (String) Base template the site design applies to: TeamSite or CommunicationSite.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the site design.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this design is applied as the default site design for its web_template.
- `preview_image_alt_text` (String) Alt text for the preview image, for accessibility.
- `preview_image_url` (String) URL of a preview image shown when choosing this design. Defaults to a generic SharePoint image if unset.
- `thumbnail_url` (String) URL of a thumbnail image for this design. Defaults to a generic SharePoint image if unset.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) GUID assigned to the site design by SharePoint.
